inputSemantics: mon_xdomain_mu_agg (continuous [0,1]; sensor: aggregate cross-domain exposure; new): aggregate cross-domain exposure consumed
mon_canary_drift_score (continuous [0,1]; sensor: canary prompts (localAIStack /observations/drift records drift today); partial): behavioral drift on canary prompts
operator_approved (binary; sensor: governance console: operator release approval; new): a distinct human operator approved the release of a latched watchdog
operator_distinct (binary; sensor: governance console: operator identity check; new): the approving operator is distinct and human
delegation_clamped (binary; aigov-delegation-clamp completion via aigov.gov16.delegation-clamp.completion): delegation depth was clamped
latch_q_prev (binary; feedback: PE: this machine's LATCH output at the previous step; new): previous LATCH output

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

rules.description: M-GOV-16 S0_Nominal → S1_DelegationThrottle: [mon_xdomain_mu_agg∈[0.7001,0.9] ∧ mon_canary_drift_score∈[0,0.15] ∧ delegation_clamped=0 ∧ latch_q_prev=0]
M-GOV-16 S2_CrossDomainBreachLatch → S0_Nominal: [mon_xdomain_mu_agg∈[0,0.5] ∧ mon_canary_drift_score∈[0,0.1] ∧ operator_approved=1 ∧ operator_distinct=1 ∧ latch_q_prev=1]

interconnections.purpose: Publish M-GOV-16's verdicts to the domain verdict aggregator.
interconnections.privacyBoundary: PE composes normalized verdict bits only.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Clamp A2A delegation depth on the offending chains.

latchFeedback.rule: Q(k) = S(k) or (not R(k) and Q(k-1)); the PE writes this machine's previous LATCH output into this element (GOV-R12).
